intent: A shade-bride's Grashan feast gown: a rich gold brocade bodice and short gold overskirt over an ivory bell skirt, slim ivory sleeves, a tall gold crown with one amber gem, and shade creeping up the hem, reading gold and ivory from the high camera.
reason: Ivory court gown: the most elegant bodice, gold with a chain necklace, over a true A-line skirt under a veil of candle spikes; the prettiest dress of the run (5.98, second; first critic 5.35, third).
first_fix: Too pale for the night and drifting toward linen: make the skirt wine or deep gold over ivory, slim the banded sleeves, and add shade-black at the hem.
